reviewItem.question: Does "The `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` cilium-agent flag didn't have any effect since v1.14 and has been deprecated" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector|component=cilium-agent (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: The cilium-agent flag --k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector has had no effect since v1.14, is now deprecated, and will be removed in v1.18.
